svg.desc: Saturn above the painting and Leo below, as Book T places them: "Above the middle wand is the sign Saturn, and below is that of Leo:" The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1791653430674-wfokbjyx4l9.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0).
